concerns.text: Task T009 (Contract test) is listed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but explicitly depends on T008 (Reference data generation). T008 is also in Phase 2. While they are in the same phase, T009 consumes the artifact of T008. The phase description states 'No user story work can begin until this phase is complete', but T009 is a test for US1. More critically, T009 requires T008 to complete. If T008 and T009 are marked [P] (parallel), this is a violation. T009 is marked [P] but depends on T008. T008 must precede T009.

Task T011 (Implement generate_partitions.py) explicitly states 'Requires T008 to complete' in its description. However, T011 is in Phase 3 (US1) and T008 is in Phase 2 (Foundational). This dependency is correctly ordered across phases. However, T011 also requires the output of T005 (asymptotic baseline) to calculate Q_as(n). T005 is in Phase 2. This is correct. But T011 also requires T004 (prime_sieve). T004 is in Phase 2. This is correct. The issue is T009 vs T008 ordering within Phase 2 if they are parallel.

Task T016a (feature_engineering.py) states 'Requires T012 completion'. T012 is in Phase 3 (US1) and T016a is in Phase 4 (US2). This is correct. However, T016a also requires the output of T005 (asymptotic baseline) to calculate R(n). T005 is in Phase 2. This is correct. The dependency chain is US1 -> US2. The issue is the explicit 'Requires T012' note which is correct, but the task T016a is marked [P] in the list? No, T016a is not marked [P]. T016b is marked [P]. T016b depends on T016a. This is a violation if T016b is parallel with T016a.

Task T016b is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but its description says 'Validate data/processed/features.csv'. This file is produced by T016a. T016b cannot run in parallel with T016a because it consumes the artifact of T016a. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Task T021 (Test Benjamini-Hochberg) states 'Must run after T017c (Implementation of correction logic)'. T021 is in Phase 4 (US2) and T017c is in Phase 4 (US2). T021 is marked [P]. T017c is not marked [P]. If T021 is parallel with other tasks in US2, it must not be parallel with T017c. The [P] tag on T021 implies it can run in parallel with T017c, which is a violation.

Task T024 (CV logic) states 'Requires T017c completion'. T024 is in Phase 5 (US3) and T017c is in Phase 4 (US2). This is correct. However, T024 is marked [P] in the list? No, T024 is not marked [P]. T022, T023a, T023b are marked [P]. T022 is a contract test for CV. T022 depends on T024? No, T022 is a test for the CV logic. T024 implements the CV logic. T022 should run after T024. T022 is marked [P]. If T022 is parallel with T024, it is a violation.

Task T022 (Contract test for CV) is marked [P] but it tests the CV logic implemented in T024. T024 is in Phase 5. T022 is in Phase 5. T022 cannot run in parallel with T024 because it consumes the artifact (or the code) of T024. The [P] tag is incorrect.

Phase 2 tasks T004, T005, T006, T007, T008, T009 are all marked [P]. However, T009 depends on T008. T008 depends on T004 (prime_sieve) and T005 (asymptotic baseline) implicitly? T008 generates reference values for p_P(n). It needs the prime_sieve (T004) to know which numbers are prime. It does not need T005 (asymptotic baseline) because it generates exact values. T009 depends on T008. So T004 -> T008 -> T009. T005 is independent of T008 and T009. T006 and T007 are independent. So T004, T005, T006, T007 can be parallel. T008 must wait for T004. T009 must wait for T008. The [P] tag on T008 and T009 is incorrect if they are in the same phase and T009 depends on T008.
